purpose: Bind one hash-checked .scscript and numeric API metadata to a supplied run reference, without claiming it was loaded or executed.
trigger: Use after an execution event when planned and actual script bytes may differ.

inputs.name: run_ref
inputs.description: Run record to bind; this is not an observed launch event.

Caller has established the actual run scope and trustworthy input provenance.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: passed; EX13 returns blocked/eligible and ER11 quarantined/deleted.

postconditions: Bind one hash-checked .scscript and numeric API metadata to a supplied run reference, without claiming it was loaded or executed.

implementation.target_environment: Windows host tooling; no SpaceClaim control or geometry mutation is implied.
